source_row.extraction_instructions: No dated listing page exists (recon was right that /events, /conferences etc all 404). The homepage's 'Conferences' mega-menu names the current set of flagship conference subsites (one <nav aria-labelledby> block per conference, each with an <h2> title and a 'Find out more' link to /conferences/<slug>) - list_shells_override() parses that instead. Each subsite is one thin page (~2KB text): a 'D-D Month YYYY' date banner, one intro paragraph naming city/country and 'and virtually' (=> hybrid), and nothing else yet - no venue name, no pricing, no CPD, no abstract text. A subsite with no parseable date banner (e.g. a past conference rewritten into a retrospective) is skipped rather than scraped as-is.

registry_comment: IAS flagship conferences (International AIDS Conference, IAS Conference on HIV Science, HIVR4P) - homepage mega-menu as listing, thin marketing subsites

spot_check.site_says: page is now a post-conference retrospective ('Rise from Rio'), no date banner
spot_check.extractor_says: correctly excluded from shells (no parseable date)

concerns: Very thin source: only 2 upcoming shells exist site-wide (IAS 2027, HIVR4P 2027), both flagship conferences ~10 months out. No pricing, CPD, venue name, or abstract info is published yet on either subsite - fields are correctly left empty/None rather than invented, but that means near-zero field coverage today. Coverage should improve automatically as IAS builds out the subsites (registration/tickets/programme sections) closer to July 2027 - re-check with the harness in a few months.

No httpx path exists for this extractor (wave1d addendum: fetch_html/httpx will likely be blocked) - list_shells_override and extract_detail both go through self.browser.navigate() only, so the harness's --force-fallback flag doesn't change behaviour here; I ran it anyway and got identical shell counts (2/2) since there's nothing for it to toggle.

The 'Conferences' mega-menu is a small, hand-maintained set (currently 3 entries: HIVR4P 2027, IAS 2027, AIDS 2026-past) rather than a real paginated index. If IAS ever runs two upcoming conferences of the same name concurrently, or restructures the menu, list_shells_override's regex on <nav aria-labelledby="menu-..."> blocks may need revisiting - flagging in case the registry maintainer wants a periodic sanity check rather than 'set and forget'.
region is set to the country name ('Switzerland'), following the convention already used by aacr.py/estro.py for non-UK sources, not a UK-style region.
Only spot-checked 2 real upcoming events by hand (there are only 2 in existence); the AIDS 2026 exclusion was verified as the third spot-check instead of a third event.
